visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Count in One Pass
visualizerParams.problemDescription: For every letter of the alphabet the whole word is scanned again. Count all letters in a single pass with a counting array. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The first version rescans the word 26 times. The counting array reads the word once and then the 26 counters once, which is far less work for long text.
